next_step: Pricing deep-dive + Dedicated perf demo (schedule week of 2026-03-24) and sign POC SOW
notes:
Stage summary: mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics pane) evaluating Hosted API first to validate embedding quality/latency, then Dedicated for predictable throughput and cost control.

Call notes (03/05 check-in):
- Customer: CTO (Ana Ruiz), Head of Search (Tom Yates), Data Eng (Priya Nair).
- "We need embeddings that match our similarity thresholds — precision at 10 > 0.85 with our internal eval set."
- Currently testing: Hosted API with embeddings endpoint -> upsert to Pinecone test project. Basic queries OK but worried about throughput and cost at scale.
- Primary ask: measurement plan for throughput (QPS), latency percentiles, and nightly batch upsert viability.
- Data concerns: customer datasets include EU customer PII; legal asked about residency + KMS integration.
- Model prefs: prefer open/quantized model variants for embeddings to reduce cost, but will accept Redwood-curated models if latency/cost tradeoffs are clear.
- Pricing sensitivity: want to keep annual spend under $150k; decision tied to ROI from faster search results and reduction in manual tagging.
- Quote from Tom: "If we can hit sub-200ms 95th percentile for UI query time + 200k nightly embeddings processed reliably, we're in."

POC scope (agreed):
- 2-week Hosted API POC to validate embedding A/B (redwood-open-embed-v1 vs open-embedding-compat).
- Run nightly batch job (target 200k embeddings/day) using Redwood streaming + bulk upsert to Pinecone; measure end-to-end throughput and failure modes.
- Small realtime route: 150 QPS sustained for UI search demo (95p latency <200ms target).
- Security: exchange SOC2 + KMS integration doc; Redwood to provide drive link to security FAQ.

Commercials & procurement:
- Early pricing conversation: exploring reserved Dedicated pool pricing if Hosted API cost per embedding > target.
- Likely path: start Hosted POC -> 6-9 month Dedicated commit if POC meets perf & cost.

Internal AE notes:
- Keep messaging tight on batching/caching optimizations (prefix caching for repeated queries).
- Offer a short Dedicated perf demo on 2 x A40-equivalent GPUs to show sustained upsert throughput.
- Prep a cost model comparing Hosted vs Dedicated (tokens/embedding units + infra markup).

technical_requirements: Targets: 95th percentile query latency <200ms for 150 QPS UI route; nightly batch: 200k embeddings/day with <6 hour processing window; compatible with Pinecone and Postgres-based metadata; ability to run bulk streaming upserts and idempotent retries; KMS key wrap for embeddings at rest; SSO/SAML for team access.
decision_criteria: 1) Meet perf targets for Hosted POC (latency + successful nightly batch) 2) Clear cost delta showing Dedicated reduces per-embedding cost by >=30% at projected volume 3) Legal signoff for data residency/KMS 4) Integration effort minimal (<4 engineer-weeks).
